reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000841 (the melody read from 000841a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. George Frederick Handel's dates (1685–1759) are from our page for the tune ANTIOCH (content/hymns/tunes/antioch.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1741. har., Arthur Seymour Sullivan has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; the tune was in print by 1741, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000841a.nwc).
